description: This file implements a Kubernetes controller for garbage collecting stale storage version entries and related leases, ensuring cleanup of outdated storage version data in the cluster.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: A controller that manages cleanup of stale storage version entries and related leases in a Kubernetes cluster.

methods.name: NewStorageVersionGC
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Controller instance, setting up event handlers for storage version and lease events.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller's worker routines and manages cache synchronization and shutdown.

methods.name: runLeaseWorker
methods.description: Processes lease deletion events in a loop.

methods.name: processNextLease
methods.description: Processes the next lease event from the queue.

methods.name: runStorageVersionWorker
methods.description: Processes storage version events in a loop.

methods.name: processNextStorageVersion
methods.description: Processes the next storage version event from the queue.

methods.name: processDeletedLease
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a lease is deleted, updating or removing associated storage version entries.

methods.name: syncStorageVersion
methods.description: Synchronizes a storage version, removing invalid entries based on lease existence.

methods.name: onAddStorageVersion
methods.description: Handles addition of a storage version object.

methods.name: onUpdateStorageVersion
methods.description: Handles updates to a storage version object.

methods.name: enqueueStorageVersion
methods.description: Enqueues a storage version for processing if it references an invalid or missing apiserver lease.

methods.name: onDeleteLease
methods.description: Handles deletion of a lease, enqueuing related storage versions for cleanup.

methods.name: enqueueLease
methods.description: Adds a lease name to the processing queue.

methods.name: updateOrDeleteStorageVersion
methods.description: Updates or deletes a storage version object based on the presence of valid server storage versions.
